text: vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ . evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto vamateva pāpake akusale dhamme no paccāvamatīti . [280] sāvatthīnidānaṃ . seyyathāpi bhikkhave sālisukaṃ vā yavasukaṃ vā sammāpaṇihitaṃ hatthena vā pādena vā akkantaṃ hatthaṃ vā pādaṃ vā bhindissati 1 lohitaṃ vā uppādessatīti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati . taṃ kissa hetu . sammāpaṇihitattā bhikkhave sukassa . evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sammāpaṇihitāya diṭṭhiyā
